authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: No Time Warp effects over extra combats (L38).

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Artifact removal or an unequipped Tetsuo turns the trigger off.
Tetsuo has to attack and survive.
The free-cast mode needs a good spell in hand.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Terminate, Withering Torment, Chaos Warp, Blasphemous Act, Cyclonic Rift.
value.mana: 35 lands with Sol Ring, Ancient Tomb, Signets and Talismans.
value.protection: Swiftfoot Boots, Oathkeeper, Mithril Coat, Deflecting Swat.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Tetsuo's attack trigger is the deck's spell engine and burn.
accepted_role.honest_note: Commander-native. Both Spellbook combos (900-3750, Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault; 3750-5039, The Reaver Cleaver + Aggravated Assault) need an attacking creature, but not Tetsuo; he is the natural carrier. The source corrected a false Relentless Assault / Seize the Day interaction (blueprint L33).
